title: §5Pick a Pocket, Go On
description: §5§oAlright rookie. I don't care if you're royalty or what. You got no experience here on Derse. You wanna prove you can rock with me? Take some of my &#FF03FEPickpocket's Gloves§5 from the &#FF03FEEast Stairwell§5 in the castle. See if you can rustle up a couple goons.
